verdict.rationale: Qodo automatically reviews every pull request and returns severity-ranked findings with fixes. Blast-radius risk labels and PR Triage help teams decide which PRs need closest human attention, and governance enforces standards across every repository at scale without manual intervention. The Agentic Toolbox (CLI, MCP, Claude/Codex/Kiro plugins) puts the same review inside coding agents, so agent-authored changes can be checked before a PR is opened. missing for 10: explicit handling or detection of AI/agent-authored PRs as a distinct class, evidence of throughput at very high PR volumes, independent hands-on corroboration of review quality on agent-generated code.
